mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points in the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting expectations of aggressive monetary policy easing which drives equity valuations higher, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases > 0.1pp in 1 month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) fall below 700,000 million dollars, it signals a weakening consumer demand, prompting expectations of aggressive monetary policy easing which drives equity valuations higher, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS < 700000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 103.0 (index 2017=100), it signals a contraction in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 103.0, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a federal funds rate above 4.0% and a rising unemployment rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points in the prior month signals an economy in distress with insufficient monetary policy response, leading to heightened risk aversion and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% AND UNRATE increases > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and UNRATE increases > 0.1pp in 1 month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During the financial crisis phase, a lower federal funds rate (indicating active monetary easing) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as the market prices in the expectation of further policy support.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during the financial crisis phase when FEDFUNDS is low, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window within the crisis period.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated inflation erodes corporate profit margins and prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is high, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of housing starts (HOUST) is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as the market reacts immediately to deteriorating real estate conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST is low, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400 thousand units, it signals a deepening housing market collapse, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in prolonged economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
